chunks: He whom God leads astray has no guardian after Him, and you see the wrongdoers, when they see the punishment, saying: 'Is there a way of return?'
ai.seo_question: What happens to those God leads astray and do they have a chance to return?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the concept of 'divine decree' (Qadr) where God's active will to mislead results in the removal of intercessors, leaving the wrongdoers without a protector. The imagery of wrongdoers seeking a 'way back' upon witnessing punishment highlights the finality of the Hereafter, contrasting with the hope of repentance available in this life. This serves as a warning that divine guidance is not merely intellectual but requires a receptive heart, and those who harden themselves face a sealed fate.
